A full card image with the corrected text set into the card and a small bronze disc at the bottom right, marking it as errata. The Players Committee showed it in its online card lists; the earliest saved copy is from 17 August 2019. Disc images of other cards were saved from May 2013, so this image may be older than its first saved copy.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-D-leiaseeker-PC-Errata-2019-disc-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Leia Seeker (PC Errata 2018 E card)]] (8 July 2018): The game text changes: “Deploys for” becomes “Use”; “an” becomes “deploy on opponent's side at any”; “Deploys and moves” becomes “Moves during your control phase,”; “an undercover spy.” becomes “a character, at normal use of the Force.”; “(or warrior)” becomes “or a warrior”; “immediately lost (treat as an "all cards" situation).” becomes “lost.”; “is” is removed. Another full card image (351 × 490 pixels): the text box is set again, and a small round bronze disc at the lower right replaces the white “E”.

The whole 2018 E card image and the whole 2019 disc card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
